title: driver-turso remote: aggregate group keys over a boolean field come back as 1/0 instead of true/false
body:
maintainer · os-bob · session_012dn2AecKpLaYkUtNRiqtby

Filing gate: ① product defect. Source: out-of-scope finding of the #37106 evaluation (PR #37120, measured 2026-11-24); maintainer 2026-11-24: 「立 Bug 卡，托管云布尔分组那个」.
Grading: area:data · Bug · Wrong result · reach: every hosted environment (the remote face of driver-turso) that groups by a boolean field in an aggregate — reports, charts, dashboards, `aggregate_records` · evidence: measured at the engine API; the HTTP door on a hosted deployment is not yet measured.

## 维护者速读
- 问题：托管云用的远程 libSQL 驱动，按布尔字段分组统计时，分组值返回 1/0（空值 null），本地驱动返回 true/false。托管云上报表、图表、问数里按「是否完成」这类字段分组，可能显示成 0/1。
- 修法：远程聚合的返回结果也走和普通读取同一套布尔转换，保证两种连接方式的值一致。
- 需要你做的：无。

## Evidence
- Measured through `ObjectQL.aggregate`, grouping by a boolean `done`:
  - SqlDriver and driver-turso local mode: `false` / `true`.
  - The hosted construction `TursoDriver({ url: 'libsql://…', client: createClient({ url: 'file:…' }) })`: `[{done:null,c:1},{done:0,c:1},{done:1,c:2}]`.
- `packages/drivers/driver-turso/src/turso-driver.ts`:
  - `aggregate()` (around line 3285) returns `remoteTransport.aggregate(...)` rows from its remote branch (around lines 3309–3318) without the read presentation that the other remote reads apply.
  - The helpers' own contract text (around line 3328) says: "These helpers run the SAME formatOutput() on remote rows so both transports agree on what a value *is*".
- Precedent: #34974 fixed the same symptom on driver-sql (`presentReadValue` had no boolean kind).

## What
1. In the remote branch of `TursoDriver.aggregate`, present the group-key columns with the same read presentation as remote `find` (boolean, and any other kind the shared presenter covers). Measures (counts, sums) are untouched.
2. Check the other remote read paths that return grouped or projected rows (`distinct`, if remote) for the same gap.

## Acceptance
- A remote-mode test running on the real libSQL engine (not the better-sqlite3 stub): grouping by a boolean answers `true` / `false` / `null`, and its output equals local mode on the same data.
- One check of the HTTP door `/api/v1/data/:object/aggregate` on a hosted-shaped boot, noted in the PR.
- Container run per AGENTS.md.

## Out of scope
- Changing `os dev`'s default database (decided against on #37106).
- The wider point that remote-mode suites mostly run on a better-sqlite3 stub (switch condition 4 in the #37106 report).

Blocked-by: none.
Related: #37106, PR #37120, #34974.
Reader: the data / drivers lane.
Dedupe: `turso remote aggregate boolean` 65 (none open on this; nearest closed #34974, driver-sql) · `aggregate boolean group key` 149 (same) · `remote aggregate formatOutput` 6 (none on this).
